headlines.title: U.S. measles deaths rise to 10 after new reports in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin
headlines.description: Total measles deaths in the United States this year rose to 10 on Friday, a grim milestone in an outbreak that has seen a record number of infections and prompted state and local health departments to ramp up vaccination efforts.

headlines.title: Stacking Skin Care: The Correct Order for Applying Products
headlines.description: With so many options and ingredients, it can be hard to know the right way to stack up your skin care. TODAY contributor and board-certified dermatologist Dr. Michelle Henry explains how actives work, the best combinations to use and the proper order for applying them.

headlines.title: New prostate cancer screening guidelines
headlines.description: The American Cancer Society released new guidelines today that changes who should get tested for prostate cancer. Most men aged 50-69 should get screened every other year and those at higher risk should get a PSA test annually. The guidelines mean that men over 70 may get tested more after consulting with their doctors. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk has the story.
